name: PostgreSQL
author: JustArtiom@users.noreply.github.com
description: Runs a PostgreSQL database with pgvector included. The console is a psql session, so you can type SQL into it.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

log() {
    printf '[System] %s\n' "$1"
}

mkdir -p /mnt/server

if [[ -f /mnt/server/postgres_db/PG_VERSION ]]; then
    log 'The server already has a database. Reinstalling keeps it as it is.'
    exit 0
fi

log 'The database is created on the first start with the user, password and database name from the startup settings.'

variables.name: Database user
variables.description: Superuser created with the database. Changing it later does not rename the existing user.

variables.name: Database password
variables.description: Password of the database user. A new password is applied on the next start.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: Database the console opens. It is created on start when it does not exist yet.
